concerns.text: FR-003 says 'If memory constraints (>7 GB) are violated without quantization, the system MUST trigger the stratified sampling strategy.' A violation-triggered behavior is only testable if the detection mechanism is observable. Specify how the >7 GB condition is detected/measured (e.g., monitored peak RSS during training) so a test can confirm the trigger fires; otherwise the fallback path cannot be verified without crashing the run.

FR-005 uses 'a multiple-comparison correction (e.g., Benjamini-Hochberg)' — the 'e.g.' leaves the actual method undetermined, so a tester cannot confirm the FR is met. SC-004 pins Benjamini-Hochberg; FR-005 should match (state BH as the required method, or name the selection rule).

SC-001 names the metric (R², RMSE) and reference (held-out test set) but states no pass/fail criterion or comparison baseline — 'to ensure generalizability' is not evaluable. Per the deferred-values convention, name what the measured values will be compared against (e.g., Null Model baseline for R²) so met-or-not is decidable at implementation time.
